cbe_8_level.EE1: Consistently exceeds the expected level for the strand and applies the competency independently in new situations.
cbe_8_level.EE2: Exceeds the expected level for the strand and explains the reasoning behind the work.
cbe_8_level.ME1: Meets the expected level for the strand independently.
cbe_8_level.ME2: Meets the expected level for the strand with occasional prompting.
cbe_8_level.AE1: Approaches the expected level and needs prompting to complete the task.
cbe_8_level.AE2: Approaches the expected level in familiar tasks only.
cbe_8_level.BE1: Below the expected level and needs structured support to begin the task.
cbe_8_level.BE2: Below the expected level and requires intensive support and guided practice.

cbe_4_level.EE: Exceeding expectations: applies the competency independently and explains the thinking.
cbe_4_level.ME: Meeting expectations: applies the competency independently in familiar tasks.
cbe_4_level.AE: Approaching expectations: applies the competency with prompting and support.
cbe_4_level.BE: Below expectations: needs structured support to demonstrate the competency.
